Folks — high-level baseline items that must be validated before we call the environment "certified":

1) Account & Identity
   - Customer or colo account ID on file (we need admin contact + billing contact).
   - Dedicated Redwood service account(s) created with scoped roles: redwood-deploy-runner, redwood-monitoring-read, redwood-kms-wrap.
   - MFA enforced on admin users; service-account keys rotated or short-lived tokens.

2) Network & Routing
   - VPC sizing with explicit CIDR allocations; reserve 10% for future expansion.
   - Peering/Transit: route tables documented; avoid overlapping CIDRs.
   - NAT and egress: list outbound proxies with IPs and port ranges (we support TCP 443, 80; occasional UDP 53 for DNS).
   - MTU/jumbo frame considerations for colo links (1500 vs 9000).
   - Health check endpoints: /healthz on port 8080 (internal) and TLS on 443 (external facing proxies).

3) Security & Key Management
   - KMS: either customer-managed CMK with cross-account usage or HSM-backed managed key (we need key ARN and usage policy).
   - TLS certificate workflow: private CA or Redwood-managed certs. Provide CSR process if private.

4) Observability & Audit
   - Audit logs (API, network flow logs, systemd/journald) forwarded to central logging endpoint (we will ingest via TLS syslog or S3).
   - Retention: minimum 30 days initially; we will confirm long-term retention after go-live.

5) Operational hygiene
   - Time sync (NTP) to Novara NTP pool; certificate validations will fail otherwise.
   - DNS: split horizon DNS entries documented; resolvers for internal names.
   - Access: bastion/Jump host, ephemeral SSH via SSM or jumpbox, and service account IMDS access restrictions.

6) Test Plan pointers (see attached baseline-test-plan.md)
   - Connectivity matrix (control plane, data plane, KV read/write).
   - End-to-end TLS handshake and latency checks.
   - KV cache and model load latencies under sample traffic.

I'll own the network gating checklist and run the smoke window if Jul 6-7 works for Novara. I attached a test plan draft.

Attachments: [baseline-test-plan.md (5 KB)]

- Ben Carter
